title: Design: streaming I/O model — UAPI contract and provider contract
description:
Before any code changes, write down the exact contract for the new streaming model in DESIGN.md.

UAPI contract:
- write() calls ops->update() immediately; output available for read() at any time
- read() without prior FINALIZE drains whatever update() has produced (may be 0 for hash)
- CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE signals end-of-input; calls ops->finalize(); sets finalized=true
- read() after FINALIZE drains final output (last CBC block, digest, GCM tag) then EOF
- write() after FINALIZE returns -EINVAL
- RESET clears finalized flag, outbuf, and provider state for same key/algo

Provider contract:
- update() MUST process all complete blocks immediately and write output to out[]/outlen
- update() MAY buffer at most one incomplete trailing block (for block ciphers)
- update() for hash/MAC produces 0 output (state update only)
- finalize() produces: last padded block (CBC), digest (hash/MAC), tag (GCM encrypt), tag-verify (GCM decrypt)
- finalize() may be called with inlen==0 (caller wrote only full blocks)

Acceptance: DESIGN.md section 'Streaming I/O Model' written and reviewed before any implementation starts.
